programme.title: Chicago P.D.
programme.desc: Continuation of Chicago Fire, "We Called Her Jelly Bean" episode. Benson has traveled into Chicago to help Voight and intelligence with a rape/murder case that is frighteningly similar to a case from New York a decade ago. She calls in Fin and Amaro to assist. The prime suspect, Yates, is let go after rigorous questioning. He then requests a meeting with Lindsay and he warns of unintended consequences from what intelligence is doing. Guest stars: Jason Beghe, Sophia Bush, Marina Squerciati, Jesse Lee Soffer, Stella Maeve from Chicago PD.

programme.title: Wings: World War Two in the Skies
programme.desc: In 1944, George Miles of Miles Aircraft came up with the idea of creating an innovative multi-purpose freighter and known as the Aerovan. The prototype flew successful in January of 1945, prompting George and brother Fred to construct additional aircraft, but a pact between the U.K and U.S. would bring a halt to production. Undeterred by this setback, the Miles brothers would press on after the war, but they would have to overcome economic hurdles to keep their company and the Aerovan alive.

programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.desc: Every year, our Montana trips deliver - and this season was no exception. Usually, Jacob's tied up filming Swamp People for the History Channel and can't make it for archery season. But this year was different. With all his gator tags filled and a little time to spare, Jacob hit the banks of the Yellow Stone River in Montana for an unforgettable hunt. The Lord painted a perfect scene, and Jacob made the most of an incredible opportunity.

programme.title: Bruce
programme.desc: Billy Chong ("Crystal Fist") plays Li, a Chinese immigrant, who comes to an Old West town looking for his uncle and gets more than he bargained for when he runs into a group of racists who has killed Tommy's (Carl Scott) family. With the help of an old martial arts expert (Leung Siu Sung), Tommy learns Kung Fu just in time for him and Li to take on the gang and avenge his family.
